unique_G=211 vs clean 215 (above the <200 Tier-S quant threshold, so the quant rule does not fire) → no quantization/compression-specific component; consistent with mild JPEG q=8 rather than heavy quantization

anisotropy_ratio=1.4446 (<1.7) + blur_pca_ratio=1.035 (isotropic kernel) → motion blur excluded, OCAB gate (anisotropy>1.7, Tier A 0% FP) NOT met → attention_type=swin, window_size=8 (window_size=16 is reserved for the motion-sev>=5 OCAB path, which does not apply)

variance_ratio=0.7898 (!=1.0, Tier A low-FP contrast-like signal), corroborated on all 5 pairs by the residual affine fit target=P+0.84*(clean-P) with per-pair var_ratio≈f^2 = 0.79/0.714/0.646/0.725/0.704 and raised clipping (pct<=1: 2.0%→0.39%) → a real contrast/global tone compression is present even though no legal single bank function reproduces f=0.84 (step4 emits NO_GLOBAL with low confidence, unmodeled_global=UNCERTAIN)

block_boundary=7.3446 (structured local JPEG, Tier S) simultaneously with variance_ratio!=1.0 (Tier A) → satisfies the Section 七 row 'variance_ratio!=1.0 + 结构化(motion/jpeg) → FiLM-GCM (+3.52)' and the flow-chart branch 'variance_ratio!=1.0? → 含 motion/jpeg? → FiLM-GCM (lr=5e-4)' → use_gcm=true

FiLM-GCM stability gate: no brightness_HSV in the pipeline (brightness ruled out: target mean shift only +5.05/255 while every bank brightness severity shifts >=17.8 gray), so the exp10 L1 / exp40 GCM-NaN combination does not apply; lr is fixed at 5e-4 per Section 七 and Section 九 (lr=5e-4 repairs the GCM NaN case)

Per-step verdicts for blur and JPEG are UNCERTAIN (severity/subtype ambiguity, PSNR 26.29<30, gap 0.03; gaussian sev3/4 and lens sev4 tied at 26.29/26.31/26.28), but the presence signals are Tier S/A and unambiguous → Section 七 explicit rule '盲识别 verdict UNCERTAIN/POOR 但 Tier S/A 信号明确 → 仍可启用组件' applies; this is not the exp37 failure mode (exp37 applied components with no signal gating at all)

finetune_strategy_ref: §七 核心原则: 信号置信度驱动组件选择 + 信号可靠性分层 (Tier S: block_boundary>1.1 0%FP; Tier A: variance_ratio!=1.0 低FP; Tier A: anisotropy>1.7 0%FP)
§七 信号→组件映射流程 (variance_ratio!=1.0 + motion/jpeg → FiLM-GCM lr=5e-4; 默认 Swin+SimpleGate+Direct)
§七 全组件启用条件 (ColorPre/FiLM-GCM/OCAB/CSN/DualBranch/SimpleGate/ColorMLP/ChannelCurve 门控表)
§六 Step 0/1/2 策略选择框架 (难度分级 → 组件; Direct vs RandomCurric vs True Ft; 按退化步骤独立匹配, UNCERTAIN 步骤不加组件)
§五 注意力类型选择 (contrast 全局 → Swin, MDTA/OCAB 崩溃; motion → OCAB) + 参数公平性规则 (Swin dim=64 454K 基线)
§八 exp37 消融 A (无门控组件 DualBranch/FiLM-GCM/ColorPre 0/24 胜, 纯 Swin 23/24) 与消融 B (True Ft ≈ Direct, 1.5h)
§九 训练崩溃诊断 (GCM 诱发 NaN 的判定与恢复: 用 best ckpt → 降 lr → 换 ColorPre → 换 pure Swin)
reasoning: Per-step evidence: JPEG presence is Tier S (block_boundary=7.3446, 0% FP), blur presence is solid but subtype/severity is UNCERTAIN (isotropic kernel PCA=1.035, anisotropy=1.4446, gaussian/lens MTF-tied at 26.29/26.28 dB), noise is excluded (sigma<2 vs x_distortion minimum 12.75), and an unmodeled contrast-like affine global compression (~0.84) is supported across all 5 support pairs by variance_ratio=f^2. The overall verdict is UNCERTAIN (PSNR 26.29, gap 0.03), but Section 七 gates on signal quality: (1) anisotropy<1.7 rules out motion → no OCAB → attention_type=swin with window_size=8; (2) variance_ratio!=1.0 (Tier A) combined with structured-local JPEG (Tier S) satisfies the FiLM-GCM gate (variance_ratio!=1.0 + 结构化), whose closest reference case exp10 L5 (contrast+motion+jpeg) gained +3.52 dB at lr=5e-4 and exp38/39 confirm GCM safety on global degradations; (3) SimpleGate is default-on (-32K params, 8/9 safe, only S5 motion -0.86, no motion here); (4) ColorPre is not stacked because the structured-local branch selects FiLM-GCM and ColorPre has the worst cross-degradation generalization (16.0 dB gap); (5) CSN, ChannelCurve, ColorMLP, DualBranch are all gated off (pure-global risk / non-triggered signals / explicit blind-scenario prohibition 0/24 in exp37). Strategy is Direct from scratch (no checkpoint exists for this support-specific challenge; True Ft ≈ Direct at 1.5h per exp37/38; pipeline contains a possible contrast-like global, for which Section 六 recommends Direct). Training uses the predicted pipeline unchanged (blur_gaussian:3 → compression_jpeg:4). Risk monitoring per Section 九: if GCM experiments show NaN or last-ckpt regression, fall back to best ckpt, then ColorPre, then pure Swin; if the JPEG/blur severity mismatch is the dominant error (predicted PSNR 26.29 < 30), validation-PSNR arbitration between the stored alternatives remains the training-time decision point.

risk_monitoring.primary_risk: UNCERTAIN severity/subtype and the unmodeled affine global (~0.84) mean training pairs do not contain the exact global tone compression; FiLM-GCM can only partially compensate if the effect is learnable from training pairs
fallback: If FiLM-GCM induces NaN or last-ckpt regression (Section 九): use best ckpt, then lr=1e-4, then swap to ColorPre, then pure Swin+SimpleGate
If GCM is not beneficial on val PSNR, rerun direct Swin+SimpleGate (exp37 23/24 baseline)
